acceptance.requirement: Active open nodes and completed prerequisites are represented separately.
A completed edge retains remote identity, full delivered commit, default branch, and evidence digest.
Completed prerequisites consume no node, frontier, slot, or attempt.
Active, satisfied, and unknown dependencies have stable machine reason codes.
A reopened prerequisite invalidates the tombstone before ready through deliverable.
Not-planned, duplicate, missing/unreachable delivery, and missing/mismatched evidence do not satisfy dependencies.
tests: LIVE a reachable delivery commit and completion-sounding comment do not satisfy an OPEN issue

acceptance.requirement: Overlaps, duplicates, identity drift, short SHA, branch drift, future time, and evidence tampering fail closed.
A v1 DAG is diagnostic-only and requires remote/evidence rebuild.
Dynamic paths cover RepositoryA, RepositoryB, and cross-repository open-to-closed transitions.
Rebuild preserves incomplete and completed edges instead of deleting or auto-satisfying them.
The gate consumes one tombstone truth table rather than parallel completion decisions.
tests: mutation catalog and executable controls are exact-set equal

acceptance.requirement: Root scheduler is Sol/low and cannot author or delete tombstones.
Only root starts a read-only fresh Sol/max DAG updater, and only remote snapshot change triggers updates.
Sol/max test owner and Sol/low implementer have disjoint actors and write leases.
Dispatch and verification receipts bind stage role, candidate SHA, remote snapshot digest, and test contract digest.
Documentation starts only after a green behavior receipt.
